findings.title: Claimed Adept acquisition conflicts with the full advancement history

asiHistory.note: Explicit legal generated-score/ASI fixture inputs; no extra feat is claimed.

evidence.observed: Positive Wizard branch claims acquired Adept Sculpt at an eligible feat milestone, but all three reached milestones are spent on scores and the supplied actor says no extra feat. The negative two-provider branch inherits the same issue when claiming both providers genuinely acquired.

findings.requestedCorrection: Supply one internally consistent full acquisition fixture with actual chosen Adept modes, milestone and source. If one reached milestone becomes a feat, reconcile starting/final scores and dependent saves/stats. Do not grant a free bonus feat. Retain genuine external feat-operational availability qualification. For the negative branch, either bind legal both-provider ownership or label its provider predicate explicitly conditional without claiming a complete acquired actor.

findings.title: Eight successful Action events leave the remaining Action ledger true

events.event: Enemy next regular start and new Fireball commitment
Next actual regular Action repeats same acquired free Reach
Enemy next genuine Action Ray of Frost at10feet
Newrealcast atsame donor, same bodyposition nowclear
Actual next-turn Fireball uses acquired Adept Sculpt, no point debit

evidence.budgetSemantics: Action/BonusAction/Reaction booleans are remaining underlying ledgers, not action eligibility outside an actual source-qualified phase or while Incapacitated. Supplied regular-START refreshes are materialized before events; explicit relevant END/idle-D transitions remain in the trace. Other uninvoked actions are declined. Long uninterrupted work/rest branches explicitly use real elapsed noncombat work, not thousands of fabricated Actions.
evidence.source: CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md:11,15; each exact procedure/native source still spends an Action.

findings.requestedCorrection: Apply the real regular-START refresh before the event, then consume the successful Action once and carry false through intermediate/terminal states until a later real refresh. Repair all full case/model/chapter/specification mirrors. Audit other cadence-normalized events for the same defect. Do not change legal rejection cases or add an Action charge to a composite Cast Echo child or a Reaction-only release.

findings.title: Successful Erase observer-exclusion branch omits casting history

evidence.observed: The caster pays17 and establishes protection on the willing subject; only the observer is excluded by a wall. lastSpell stays null and the used matrix-family list stays empty.

findings.requestedCorrection: Record actual erase-from-reality casting history and the spent prepared-family exemption at commitment in every mirror. Preserve zero base Dissonance for this real first prepared cast, the valid subject protection, and the excluded observer. This is not an illegal-cast refund case.
